product.title: Deep-v Brace Dress
product.description: HAELO Deep-v Brace Dress in Black is an unlined fluid maxi dress in 96% viscose and 4% elastane, with an adjustable halterneck, deep V neckline, cross-back straps, and a back zipper. The shoulder-to-hem length is approximately 60 inches. Dry clean; made in China.
